help.levels_message: Define the levels in your organisation hierarchy before building your tree. Example: Factory → Region → Warehouse.
help.levels_tip: You can rename levels at any time. However, you cannot add or remove levels once you have started building your organisation tree. To restructure your organisation, contact support.
help.tree_message: Build your organisation structure by adding nodes at each level. Start with your top-level node (e.g. Factory A) then add children below it.
help.tree_tip: If you have multiple factories or independent branches, add each as a separate top-level node here. Each branch can have its own structure and depth. To close a location, deactivate it using the node menu — this hides it from new transfers while preserving all historical data. Deactivation requires zero stock on hand, no open transfers, and all staff reassigned.
help.positions_message: Create positions for each node in your organisation tree. Positions define who holds authority at each location and are used for approval routing and audit logging.
help.positions_tip: We recommend at least two positions per node (main and assistant) to ensure coverage when staff are unavailable.
help.transfer_types_message: Customise the display names for the three transfer types. These names appear on all screens, reports, and approval notifications across your organisation.
help.transfer_types_tip: Choose names your staff will recognise from daily operations — for example 'Stock Request' instead of 'Request Stock'.
help.approval_rules_message: Configure when transfers and adjustments require approval and who must approve them. Rules are matched by quantity range and organisation level.
help.approval_rules_tip: After saving your rules, visit the Approval Policies page to verify they display correctly in plain language.
help.personnel_message: Add staff members and assign them to positions in your organisation. A person must be assigned to a position before they can perform operational tasks.
help.personnel_tip: A person can hold multiple positions if they cover more than one area.
help.branding_message: Upload your organisation logo (max 1MB, JPG/PNG/WebP — shown in navigation) and banner image (max 3MB, JPG/PNG/WebP — shown on dashboard).

hero.subtitle: Real-time stock ledger · FEFO dispatch · Offline barcode scanning · 3-layer security — built for Ethiopian producers and distributors.

features.heading: Everything your warehouse team needs
features.subheading: From barcode scanning on the warehouse floor to AI-powered demand forecasting.

ledger.title: Immutable Inventory Ledger
ledger.desc: Every stock movement is an append-only INSERT. Balances are derived — nothing is ever overwritten or deleted.

rbac.title: RBAC + ABAC Security
rbac.desc: 115 permission actions enforced at 3 layers: API Gateway, service level, and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security.

hierarchy.title: Multi-Location Hierarchy
hierarchy.desc: Production centers, warehouses, and sub-centers in a parent–child tree. Users are auto-scoped to their location.

offline.title: Offline PWA + Barcode Scan
offline.desc: Record movements offline via camera scan. IndexedDB queue syncs automatically when connectivity returns.

dispatch.title: FEFO Dispatch Engine
dispatch.desc: Auto-enforced when expiry tracking is active. Override requires explicit permission + reason code + audit trail.

i18n.title: EN · Amharic · Oromifa
i18n.desc: Language packs served from S3 CDN, cached by service worker. Switch per-user. Native speaker review for Oromifa.
